# R6.12 — REPLAY + ARCHIVE (a): record/replay modes, `RequestCanonicalizer`, `RecordedTransport`, `hh-receipt-index/1` + condenser (manifest 265)

- **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent
- **Branch:** `codex/harnessharness-r6.12` · base `origin/main` @ `2d78814` (R6.11 tip, PR #305)
- **Merge policy:** OPERATOR — PR opened, not merged.
- **Layer:** engineered — offline-only, USD $0.00; every upstream leg is a loopback fixture or a recorded sequence (REQ-XC-125). No live claims.
- **Stages:** the contract's Stage-1/Stage-2 boundary landed in one pass; recording + replay share `core_.rs`/`replay.rs`, so a partial tree would not compile. Recorded as a deviation.

## Landed

**REPLAY (§4.9; REQ-XC-122 absorbs REQ-XD-108; design/33 F15; design/36 §1.3/P1–P9):**

- **`hh.model_proxy.recording/1`** (`proxy/replay.rs`) — the one recording format: per call `k`, downstream request bytes (capture point 1), upstream-bound body after lane transforms (capture point 2 — the match key, what the model conditions on), verbatim upstream `{status, headers, body, chunk_stamps}`, released downstream bytes, §4.3 disposition, recorded latency. `provenance ∈ recorded | synthetic` (P6); closed codec — unknown members refuse. `record` mode captures per slot in-memory; `seal_recording{slot_id}` deposits the manifest (leak-scanned like every blob) and lands `model.proxy.recording.sealed` (new class-table row, `O::ModelIo`, lowering `none` — the proxy is sole writer).
- **`ProxyMode ∈ {live, record, replay}`.** `replay` binds `ReplayConfig{recordings, canonicalizer_id, cell_facts, strict, keying ∈ sequence|sequence_then_hash, latency ∈ immediate|recorded}` at configure; an unknown canonicalizer spelling refuses at configure. **No upstream port** (catalog probe skipped, transport never dialed) and **no budget charge by construction** — replay allocates no root pool and no slot slice: zero `control.budget.*`/`measurement.cost.attributed` rows (AC-1).
- **`RequestCanonicalizer`** (`hh-gateway::replay`) — `canonicalize(surface, bytes) → Canonical{bytes, dropped_paths}`. Built-ins: `identity` (byte equality), `json_canonical` (`parse_provider` → `Json::to_canonical_string` — the one canonicalizer, CC1), `hh-l1-canon` (the existing `L1Canon` view; `hh-wire`'s `first_diff` exposed as `first_diff_path` — no second comparator). `match_requests` returns `exact | canonical_equal | diverged{first_diff_path}`; a canonicalizer refusal degrades to `diverged{canon_error}`.
- **Replay serve** — sequence position = slot call ordinal (smallest unserved index); `sequence_then_hash` scans outstanding calls for a canonical-hash match first (F15's interleaved repair). A slot-bound locally-refused request consumes one index (`verdict: refused_local`) so record-mode trajectories stay aligned. Strict stops with typed 409 `replay_diverged` carrying `first_diff_path` and **ends the slot** (later requests refuse the same); lenient serves and records the verdict — never gate evidence (P4). Sequence end → typed 409 `replay_exhausted` (P5). The receipt's `proxy.mode` is `live|record|replay` and `proxy.replay` carries `{k, verdict, first_diff_path?, canonicalizer, keying, strict, dropped_paths?}` (P2/P8 — the upstream-bound transform runs before the match; the downstream equality is diagnostic).
- **Streaming replay (P7)** — a `stream:true` request serves the recorded SSE head + the recorded body re-chunked by the recorded `chunk_stamps` lengths (`rechunk` — the declared deterministic rule); non-streaming serves byte-identically. `latency: recorded` sleeps the recorded call latency before release (P9).
- **`RecordedTransport`** (`hh-gateway`) — a `Transport` serving the same recording rows to native runs through the extracted `decode_exchange_frames` (`HttpModelTransport::raw_frames`' own decoding path — no second decoder): emitted `WireFrame`s equal the live decode of the same bytes (AC-1 leg). `send` past the sequence → typed `replay_exhausted`; `with_matcher` records per-call verdicts and refuses `replay_diverged` when strict.

**ARCHIVE (a) (§4.10; REQ-XF-124, REQ-XH-101; AR-20):**

- **`hh-receipt-index/1`** (`hh-runner::receipt_index`) — the committed record (never an authoritative store): `dataset{repo, revision, visibility}`, per-attempt `files[]` over the closed role set `{raw_receipts, transcript, atif, egress_log, native_log, store_segment}`, pass `artifacts[]` over `{layer_export, bundle, binary_set}` with `upload ∈ archived | digest_only` (digest_only carries no uploaded path — refused by constructor and codec), `scans{secret_scan_ref, contamination_scan_ref}`, `supersedes[]`, `tombstone{reason}`. Closed codec — malformed entries refuse typed.
- **`packet_fold`** — `{consumed_micros, calls, receipts, dispositions}` folded from durable `(class, payload)` rows; recomputing it from archived store-segment events equals the committed packet (the AC-5 fixture pins the fold shape).
- **`condense`** (`hh-runner::condenser`) — deterministic `transcript.jsonl`: a `trial` header, positional message dedup (each request's `messages[]` resends the prefix; only the tail lands — each message stored once), one `call` line per receipt carrying `{k, model_call_id, disposition, usage{input/output/cache_read}, latency_ms, queue_wait_ms, released_status, tool}`. Two runs over the same receipts are byte-identical. Every emitted line passes `hharness-secrets::redact` with the caller's `DetectorSet` — the R6.23 scan's tombstone hook (a `MaskSet` carrying a revoked slot token tombstones the derived file; hits returned). `hh-runner` gains `hharness-secrets` (downward edge; runner-edges green).

**Offline enforcement (REQ-XC-125):**

- `scripts/check-proxy-offline.sh` — fails when a proxy test names a non-loopback endpoint literal without `#[ignore]` + ADR-0363 (a seeded live test was verified to trip it). CI step `Proxy offline-only check` gated `mode != 'fast'`.

## Verify

- `cargo test -p hharness-hosting --test r6_12` — **13/13**: byte-identical replay with zero budget rows + `mode:replay` receipts + `exact` verdicts; record→seal→replay round trip (manifest + `model.proxy.recording.sealed`); strict divergence 409 + `first_diff_path=messages[0].content` + slot ended; lenient serves + records; canonicalizer built-ins match/mismatch (`json_canonical` rides `to_canonical_string`); `hh-l1-canon` masks stream/session-id but not content; typed `replay_exhausted`; synthetic ingest + malformed refusal; slot-token binding; `sequence_then_hash` out-of-order; rechunk + SSE-head serve; used-set exhaustion.
- `cargo test -p hharness-gateway --test r6_12` — **4/4**: `RecordedTransport` frames = `decode_exchange_frames` frames (JSON + SSE, timestamp parity); typed exhaustion; matcher verdicts + strict `replay_diverged`; verdict ladder `exact → canonical_equal → diverged{path}`.
- `cargo test -p hharness-runner --test r6_12` — **3/3**: index codec (every file+artifact role, `digest_only` no-path, malformed refusals); condenser determinism + dedup + tombstone hook; fold recompute + `git ls-files` no-archive-bytes.
- Regression: r6_10 **11/11**, r6_11 **18/18** — receipt shape/ordering unchanged (`mode` is the only new member; `proxy.replay` is `null` for live/record).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` — clean · scoped `cargo clippy -p hharness-hosting -p hharness-gateway -p hharness-runner -p hharness-wire -p hharness-ledger -- -D warnings` — clean · `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p …` — clean · `bash scripts/check-runner-edges.sh` — OK · `bash scripts/check-proxy-offline.sh` — PASS (seeded live test verified to fail it) · `bash "$AGENT_SKILLS_ROOT/skills/build-memory/scripts/adr-index.sh" docs/adr` — regenerated.
- Guard: `PASS DISPATCH — R6.12` pre; **post-guard `PASS`, route `DISPATCH — R6.13`** (check-supplement-guard v1.1.0).

## Deviations

- **Changed source+test lines above the ≤1600 split trigger** — recorded (replay serve + recording codec concentrate in `core_.rs`/`replay.rs`; the contract warns the trigger is a split signal, not a halt).
- **Stage 1 + Stage 2 in one pass** — recording and replay share files; recorded.
- **`identity` canonicalizer + `to_provider_string` sorting** — replay compare keys on upstream-bound bytes as emitted; a hand-authored synthetic `upstream_request` must use provider-serialized (sorted) bytes or it diverges `diverged{bytes}` — fixture fixed; recorded as a fixture-authoring note.
- **Pre-existing clippy noise** (`r5_19.rs` `default_constructed_unit_structs` on `--all-targets`) — untouched, recorded.
